blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) record the full spectrum of light at every pixel, so projecting an HSI through a camera's spectral sensitivities gives that camera's RAW image, and one HSI can supply training data for hyperspectral reconstruction and camera-pipeline methods. Real HSIs, however, are slow and expensive to capture, and the largest datasets hold only about 1,000 images. High-level vision commonly replaces scarce real data with images rendered from 3D scenes. Low-level tasks, however, need physically correct spectra, which requires spectral rendering with a measured spectrum for every material in a scene, and existing spectral renderings cover only a handful of scenes, mostly with a simplified image formation model. We present Spectrify, a framework that converts 3D scene datasets into HSIs, together with a library of reflectance spectra labeled by material and compiled from close-range hyperspectral datasets and spectrophotometer measurements. In Spectrify, spectra follow the material: each object receives a physically based optical model and measured reflectance spectra or optical constants from its material category, each lamp an emission spectrum of its type and the sky a modeled daylight spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 path-traces the full light transport of each scene per wavelength. We show that a hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our synthetic HSIs generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on the largest real HSI datasets on most test sets, and that assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set. RAW images projected from our HSIs are also useful training data for color constancy, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.
blocks.zh: 超光谱图像(HSI)记录了每个像素的全部光谱,因此通过相机的光谱敏感度投射出一个HSI可以给相机的RAW图像,一个HSI可以提供超光谱再生和相机管方法的训练数据. 然而,真实的HSI缓慢而昂贵的捕捉,最大的数据集只持有约1000个图像. 高水平的视野通常会用从3D场景得到的图像来取而代之的稀缺真实数据. 然而,低等任务需要物理上正确的光谱,这需要光谱渲染,对一个场景中的每一个材料都具有被测量到的光谱,而现有的光谱渲染只覆盖了少数场景,大部分是使用简化的图像形成模型. 我们提出Spectrify,一个将三维场景数据集转换为HSIs的框架,以及一个由材料标记的反射光谱库,从近距离超光谱数据集和分光分光计测量中编译而成. 在"光谱"中,光谱跟随了材料:每个物体从物质类别得到一个物理光学模型并测量出反射光谱或光学常数,每个灯具有其类型的排放光谱和天空有模型的日光光光谱,而Mitsuba 3路径跟踪每个场景按波长进行的全部光传输. 我们显示,一个高光谱重建网络只受过合成HSI的训练,它比大多数测试集中最大的真正HSI数据集的网络更好地概括到看不见的真实数据集,而且按照材料类别而不是单用颜色来分配光谱可以改善每个测试集的这种传输。 我们的高级研究所预测的RAW图像也是关于颜色稳定性的有用培训数据,与现有的合成RAW发电机相同。 我们发布了4500个HSI,Spectrify的代码及其材料标记的反射库.

Figure 1 : Overview of Spectrify . Spectrify renders existing indoor and outdoor 3D scenes into hyperspectral images.
Each object part receives measured reflectance spectra of its material category from our library (bottom left), and each lamp and the sky an emission spectrum such as daylight, incandescent or LED light (top).
Path tracing renders the scene, and projecting the resulting hyperspectral image through the spectral sensitivities of a camera gives that camera’s RAW image.
Spectral rendering thus makes it possible to synthesize training data for many applications, from hyperspectral images and per-pixel illumination maps to aligned images of different sensors (right).

每个物体部分从我们的库(左下方)得到其材料类别的测量反射光谱,每个灯和天空得到日光、白炽或LED灯(顶端)等排放光谱。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Learned low-level vision methods require large training sets, and for methods that operate on RAW images these sets are tied to a specific camera.
The RAW values a camera records are determined by its optical system, i.e. its lens, filters and sensor, whose combined spectral response is described by the spectral sensitivity functions (SSFs).
Cameras with different optical systems therefore have different SSFs and record different RAW values for the same scene and illumination [ 53 ] , so a model trained on data from one camera degrades on another. Training data must therefore be collected for each camera, by capturing the same scenes again with every new device [ 36 ] .
For phone cameras, which change every year, this collection has to be repeated for each new model.
blocks.zh:
学习到的低水平视觉方法需要大型培训集,对于在RAW图像上操作的方法,这些集与特定的相机相连.
RAW值一个相机记录由它的光学系统决定,即它的镜头,滤波器和传感器,其综合光谱反应由光谱敏感函数(SSF)描述.
因此,具有不同光学系统的相机有不同的SSF,记录同一场景的不同RAW值并进行照明[53],因此一个从一个相机上训练的数据模型在另一个相机上降解. 因此,必须收集每台相机的培训数据,用每台新设备再次拍摄相同的场景[36]。
对于每年变化的电话摄像头来说,每款新型号都要重复这种收藏.

blocks.en:
To avoid recapturing data for every camera, prior work synthesizes RAW training data from existing sRGB images by inverting the image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, an approach known as unprocessing [ 13 , 53 ] .
Each ISP step is undone with a simple parametric operation, which brings an sRGB image back to the linear RAW space of a target camera.
These inverses assume a single, known pipeline, whereas real sRGB images carry diverse and unknown photo-finishing, so the inversion does not reliably recover the scene-referred linear signal [ 36 ] .
RawGen [ 36 ] instead learns the mapping with a diffusion model that turns sRGB images, or images generated from text prompts, into linear CIE XYZ, which calibration matrices then convert to a camera’s RAW space.
A diffusion prior, however, can hallucinate content [ 38 , 49 ] , and three channels cannot resolve metamerism: spectra that look identical in XYZ can differ for the camera [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh:
为避免每台相机的数据重现,先前的工作通过反转图像信号处理(ISP)管道,从现有的sRGB图像中合成RAW训练数据,这种方法被称为不处理[13,53].
每个ISP步骤都会被简单的参数化操作所抵消,这把SRGB的图像带回目标相机的线性RAW空间.
这些反向假设一个单一的,已知的管道,而真实的SRGB图像携带着多样的,未知的摄影成像,因此反向无法可靠地恢复场景中指的线性信号[36].
RawGen [36] 转而用一种扩散模型来学习映射,将sRGB图像或文本提示生成的图像转化为线性CIE XYZ,然后校准矩阵转换成相机的RAW空间.
然而,先扩散可以产生幻觉内容[38,49],三个通道无法解决元论:XYZ中外观相同的光谱可以对相机[34]不同.

blocks.en:
Hyperspectral images give a more controlled source of sensor data.
An HSI keeps the wavelength-resolved light of a scene, so projecting it through the SSFs of any camera simulates that camera’s RAW image [ 59 , 34 ] , and one HSI serves every sensor with known SSFs [ 35 ] .
Real HSIs, however, are even scarcer [ 28 , 18 , 64 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 68 , 43 , 50 , 21 ] than RAW data: scanning hyperspectral cameras need static scenes and can take from tens of seconds to minutes per capture [ 17 , 37 ] .
ARAD 1K [ 7 ] , one of the largest natural-scene datasets and a standard benchmark for hyperspectral reconstruction, contains about a thousand images, which is small as a training set for modern learned methods [ 65 , 27 ] .
Because hyperspectral capture is costly, such datasets are usually recorded with a single camera in one region, so they cover a narrow range of content and lighting.
blocks.zh:
超光谱图像提供了更受控制的传感器数据来源.
一个HSI保持一个场景的波长解析光线,因此通过任何相机的SSF投影,模拟相机的RAW图像[59,34],一个HSI服务于每个已知SSF的传感器[35].
然而,真实的HSI比RAW数据更稀少[28,18,64,5,6,7,68,43,50,21]:扫描超光谱摄像头需要静态场景,每次捕捉可以持续数十秒到几分钟[17,37].
ARAD 1K [7],是最大的自然-场景数据集之一,是超光谱重建的标准基准,包含约1000幅图像,作为现代学习方法的培训集小[65,27].
由于超光谱捕捉成本很高,这类数据集通常在一个区域用单摄像头录制,因此覆盖了范围狭窄的内容和照明.

blocks.en:
Spectral rendering can remove this bottleneck.
High-level vision already relies on rendered datasets with exact per-pixel labels [ 51 , 63 , 52 , 67 ] .
A physically based renderer that traces light at every wavelength, such as Mitsuba 3 [ 33 ] , can likewise produce HSIs of any 3D scene, with spectral shading, interreflections, and mixed lighting [ 31 ] .
What such a renderer needs, and what 3D scene datasets lack, is a spectrum for every material, texture, and light source.
Graphics2RAW [ 53 ] mentions spectral rendering as an alternative way to synthesize RAW images but considers it significantly more complicated, since it needs spectra for the whole scene and the SSFs of the target camera.
Rendered synthetic HSI datasets therefore remain small, with spectra assigned by color from a limited set [ 31 ] or per material in a few purpose-built scenes [ 54 , 41 ] .
Assigning spectra by color, however, is not enough, because surfaces of the same color can have different spectra [ 24 ] , and a color match can then pick the spectrum of the wrong material.
blocks.zh:
光谱渲染可以消除这个瓶颈.
高层视野已经依赖于每个像素标签准确的数据集[51,63,52,67].
基于物理的渲染器,如Mitsuba 3 [33] ,在每一波长处跟踪光线,同样可以产生任何三维场景的HSI,并带有光谱阴影、内射和混合照明[31]。
这种渲染器需要的,以及3D场景数据集缺少的,是每个材料,纹理,光源的光谱.
Graphics2RAW [53] 提到光谱渲染是合成RAW图像的替代方法,但认为它要复杂得多,因为它需要整个场景的光谱以及目标镜头的SSF.
合成 因此,HSI数据集仍然很小,从一个有限的集[31]或者在几个目的构建的场景中按照颜色分配光谱[54,41].
然而,通过颜色来指定光谱是不够的,因为同一颜色的表面可以有不同的光谱[24],一个颜色匹配可以然后选择错误材料的光谱.

blocks.en:
In this work we present Spectrify , a framework that generates HSIs by physically based spectral rendering of existing 3D scene datasets.
It reads the material information stored in 3D assets and uses it to select measured reflectance spectra from a large material-labeled library that we compile, so no spectrum is assigned by hand and no reflectance is inferred from color alone.
Lamps and skies receive physically plausible emission spectra, and spectral path tracing renders each scene into an HSI, from which aligned RAW images of any camera with known SSFs follow ( Fig. 1 ).
Models trained on this data transfer to real images on two downstream tasks, hyperspectral reconstruction and color constancy.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们呈现Spectrify ,这个框架通过物理上的光谱渲染现有3D场景数据集生成HSI.
它读取存储在3D资产中的材料信息,并用它从我们所编译的大型材料标签库中选择测量的反射光谱,因此没有光谱通过手分配,也没有光彩推断出反射光谱.
灯光和天空接收到物理上可信的发射光谱,光谱路径跟踪使每个场景都变成一个HSI,从中将任何相机的RAW图像与已知的SSF对齐(图1)。
有关这种数据传输到真实图像的模型在两个下游任务,即超光谱重建以及色彩恒定性方面接受了培训.

blocks.en:
In summary, our contributions are: • Spectrify , a framework that converts existing 3D scene datasets into HSIs by physically based spectral rendering and uses material categories to assign optical models and select measured reflectance spectra. • An evaluation of the rendered data on hyperspectral reconstruction and on color constancy from RAW images.
For hyperspectral reconstruction, models trained on our data generalize to unseen real datasets better than models trained on prior synthetic data and, on most test sets, better than models trained on the largest real HSI datasets, and assigning spectra by material category improves this transfer.
For color constancy, RAW images projected from our HSIs perform on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. • A release of 4,500 HSIs of indoor and outdoor scenes rendered with Spectrify , together with the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.
blocks.zh:
总而言之,我们的贡献是: 光谱——一个通过物理光谱渲染将现有的3D场景数据集转换成HSI的框架,并使用物质类别来指定光学模型和选择测量的反射光谱. 评估RAW图像提供的关于超光谱重建的数据和颜色稳定性的数据。
在超光谱重建方面,我们数据培训的模型概括到无形的真实数据集,比以前合成数据培训的模型更好,在大多数测试数据集上,比最大的真实的HSI数据集培训的模型更好,按材料类别分配光谱可以改进这种传输。
对于色彩恒定性,来自我们高压源的RAW图像与现有的合成RAW生成器相同。 • 支助 发行了4,500 HSI的室内和室外场景,配有Spectrify, 以及Spectrify的代码及其材料标记的反射库.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Synthetic Data Generators Most synthetic training data for low-level vision is derived from existing sRGB images.
UPI [ 13 ] inverts the ISP pipeline to turn sRGB images into RAW, and Graphics2RAW [ 53 ] maps graphics images to the RAW space of a specific camera using its DNG metadata.
Buzzelli et al . [ 14 ] apply the same idea to spectra and replace each sRGB pixel with the most similar reflectance from a set such as Munsell [ 45 ] or RidiQulous [ 48 ] .
These methods assume one known photo-finishing pipeline; RawGen [ 36 ] removes this assumption by training a diffusion model to map differently photo-finished sRGB versions of a scene to one linear CIE XYZ image.
All of them, however, infer RAW values or spectra from the three channels of an existing image.
blocks.zh:
合成数据生成器 大多数低水平视觉的合成训练数据都是从现有的SRGB图像中得出的.
UPI [13]将ISP管道反转将sRGB图像转换为RAW,Graphics2RAW [53]将图形图像映射到使用DNG元数据的特定相机的RAW空间.
Buzzelli et al. [14] 对光谱应用相同的想法,并用Munsell [45] 或 RidiQulous [48] 等集中最相似的反射替换每个sRGB像素.
这些方法假设一个已知的照相完成管道; RawGen [36] 通过训练一个传播模型来将一个场景的照相完成的sRGB版本映射到一个线性CIE XYZ图像,从而去除这一假设.
然而,它们都从现有图像的三个通道推断RAW值或光谱.

blocks.en:
Rendering 3D scene datasets [ 51 ] avoids this dependence on existing images and provides diverse ground truth [ 20 ] , but the spectra that spectral rendering needs are laborious to prepare for each dataset [ 53 , 31 ] .
Previous spectral generators therefore either choose spectra regardless of material or assign them per material in only a handful of scenes.
MIST [ 31 ] gives each color the spectrum closest in chromaticity from a small set of measured spectra.
HyViD [ 54 ] crops textures by hand from a hyperspectral dataset [ 5 ] , and in SWR [ 41 ] a coding agent builds a few worlds whose spectra come from the material-labeled ECOSTRESS [ 44 ] and USGS [ 39 ] libraries. Spectrify gives every surface spectra of its own material automatically, so it converts whole 3D scene datasets instead of a handful of scenes.
blocks.zh:
渲染3D场景数据集 [51] 避免了这种对现有图像的依赖,提供了多样的地面真理 [20],但光谱渲染需要的光谱对于每个数据集的准备[53,31]是费力的.
因此,以前的光谱生成器要么选择光谱,而不论材料如何,要么只在少数场景中分配每个材料。
MIST [31] 从一小组测量光谱中给出在色度上最接近的每个色谱.
HyViD[54]作物纹理从一个超光谱数据集[5],在SWR[41]中,一个编码代理构建了几个世界,其光谱来自材料标记的ECOSTRESS[44]和USGS[39]库. 光谱会自动地给自己材料的每一个表面光谱,因此它会转换整个3D场景数据集,而不是一小堆场景.

blocks.en:
Spectral Rendering Most rendering engines aim at visually realistic images and compute light transport in a tristimulus color space, which approximates products of spectra by products of three channel values and so cannot be physically accurate for every combination of light and material [ 57 , 56 ] .
Physically based engines PBRT [ 46 ] , ART [ 61 ] , Hydra [ 25 ] , and Mitsuba 3 [ 33 ] can instead trace light at sampled wavelengths and output spectral radiance.
These engines solve light transport but leave the spectra of materials and light sources to the user.
We use Mitsuba 3 because all its material models support spectral rendering and its Python API lets us build scenes from code.
blocks.zh:
光谱渲染 大多数渲染引擎都以视觉上现实的图像为目标,在三进制色空间中计算光传输,通过三种通道值的产品来近似光谱产品,因此对于光和材料的每一种组合都不可能在物理上准确[57,56].
基于物理的发动机PBRT [46],ART [61],Hydra [25],和Mitsuba 3 [33] 可以在取样的波长和输出光谱光度时追踪光线.
这些引擎能解决轻便运输,但将材料和光源的光谱留给用户.
我们使用Mitsuba 3是因为它的所有物质模型都支持光谱渲染,它的Python API让我们用代码构建场景.

blocks.en:
Reflectance Libraries Measured reflectance spectra have been collected for color research, the study of metamerism, and remote sensing.
Collections from color research range from the 1,995 surface spectra of Barnard et al . [ 8 ] , including Munsell chips [ 45 ] , to the 25M distinct reflectances that Zhang et al . [ 66 ] gather to study metamer mismatching and the 43M spectra of RidiQulous [ 48 ] , with reduced versions of 7M and 114K.
These collections do not label their spectra by material, so a spectrum can be drawn from them only by its color.
USGS [ 39 ] and ECOSTRESS [ 44 ] label their spectra by material and SOCS [ 55 ] by object type, but these libraries are small and cover few material classes.
Existing libraries are thus either large or labeled by material, but not both.
Our library is both large and labeled by material.
blocks.zh:
现已收集了用于色素研究、元论研究和遥感的测量反射光谱。
从彩色研究收集的从巴纳德等人的1,995个表面光谱[8],包括Munsell芯片[45],到张等人收集的用于研究元器件不匹配的25M不同反射和RidiQulous的43M光谱[48],减少的版本为7M和114K.
这些收藏没有用材料来标注它们的光谱,所以一个光谱只能用它的颜色来画.
USGS[39]和ECOSTRESS[44]用材料标注他们的光谱,SOCS[55]则按对象类型标注,但这些库规模小,覆盖的材料类很少.
因此,现有的图书馆要么是大型的,要么是贴有材料的标签,但并非两者兼有。
我们的图书馆既大又贴有材料标签。

blocks.en: 3 The Spectrify Framework
blocks.zh: 3 光谱框架

blocks.en:
Spectrify takes a 3D scene, with the arrangement and textures of its objects and the placement of its light sources, and gives every object a spectral material and every light source an emission spectrum.
The material category of each object part follows from the object it belongs to.
This category selects both the optical model of the part and the pool of measured spectra it can receive, and the texture then selects spectra within that pool.
blocks.zh:
光谱拍摄了3D场景,其物体的排列和纹理以及光源的布置,使每个物体都有光谱材料,每个光源都有排放光谱.
每个物体部分的物质类别都遵循它所属的物体.
此类既选择部分的光学模型,又选择其能接收的测量光谱集合,纹理再在该集合中选择光谱.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows the pipeline.
We first compile a library of measured reflectance spectra labeled by material category ( Sec. 3.1 ).
We then determine material categories from the object and material names of a 3D scene and assign optical models, and every light source of the scene receives an emission spectrum ( Sec. 3.2 ).
Each surface then receives reflectance spectra from its category that match its source colors ( Sec. 3.3 ).
Finally, Mitsuba 3 renders the scene by spectral path tracing ( Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
图2显示管道。
我们首先汇编了一个按材料类别标注的测量反射光谱库(第3.1节)。
然后我们从一个三维场景的物体和物质名称中确定材料类别,并指定光学模型,场景的每一个光源都得到一个排放光谱(第3.2条)。
每个表面然后从与其源颜色相符的类别中接收反射光谱(第3.3节)。
最后,Mitsuba 3通过光谱路径追踪使现场(第3.4节).

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : The Spectrify pipeline. A 3D scene is read into a description of its objects and light sources.
Each object receives a material category, which fixes its optical model and the pool of library spectra it can receive, and its texture color selects spectra within that pool.
Each light source receives an emission spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 renders a 31-band hyperspectral image by spectral path tracing.

图2 :光谱管道. 3D场景被解读为对其物体和光源的描述.

blocks.en: 3.1 A Material-Labeled Reflectance Library
blocks.zh: 3.1 材料辅助反思图书馆

blocks.en:
Each material category needs enough labeled spectra to cover the colors it takes in 3D scenes.
Close-range hyperspectral images provide such numbers but are mostly unlabeled, while spectrophotometer measurements are labeled but few, so we use both: about 16,600 close-range hyperspectral images and 29K spectrophotometer measurements from 70 datasets.
We take 63 material categories from existing material-labeled datasets [ 11 , 58 , 1 , 2 ] .
Spectrophotometer measurements and annotated hyperspectral datasets come with labels that we map to these categories.
Unannotated hyperspectral images are rendered to RGB and segmented with Segment Anything Model 3 [ 16 ] , using the category names as text prompts.
Each labeled pixel of a hyperspectral image and each measurement gives one spectrum, about 370M in total.
All spectra are resampled to the 31 rendering bands ( Sec. 3.4 ).
Spectra are stored as absolute reflectance in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , not normalized to unit peak, so a material keeps its brightness as well as its spectral shape.
Library statistics and the list of source datasets are given in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
每个物质类别都需要足够的标记光谱,以覆盖它在3D场景中所需的颜色.
近距离超光谱图像提供这种数字,但大多没有标签,而光谱光度计的测量则贴上标签,但很少,因此我们既使用这两种方法:大约16,600个近距离超光谱图像,又使用70个数据集的29K光谱光度计的测量。
我们从现有材料标记数据集中抽取63个材料类别[11、58、1、2]。
分光摄氏度计测量和带注释的超光谱数据集都有我们绘制到这些类别的标签。
无附加说明的超光谱图像向 RGB 渲染, 并用分块任意模式 3 [16] 进行分割, 使用分类名称作为文本提示 。
一个超光谱图像的每个标注像素,每次测量都给出一个光谱,总共约370M.
所有光谱被重印到31个渲染波段(第3.4节).
光谱作为绝对反射存储在[0, 1] [0, 1]中,不常态化为单位峰值,因此一种材料保持其亮度及其光谱形状.
图书馆统计和源数据集列表见附录A。

blocks.en: 3.2 Material and Light Assignment
blocks.zh: 3.2 物资和轻型运输

blocks.en:
This step turns the objects and lamps of a source scene into materials and light sources for spectral rendering: each object part receives a material category, which fixes its optical model, and each lamp receives an emission spectrum.
We apply it to 3D-FRONT [ 26 ] interiors and to city and natural scenes that we build from third-party asset collections [ 2 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh:
这一步骤将源场景的物体和灯具转化为光谱渲染的材料和光源:每个物体部分得到一个材料类别,这个类别可以修正其光学模型,每个灯具得到一个排放光谱.
我们把它应用于3D-FRONT [26] 内部,以及我们从第三方资产收藏中构建的城市和自然场景[2,1].

blocks.en:
Material categories Objects can consist of several parts with different materials, such as a chair with a wooden frame and a fabric seat, so each part receives its own category, read from its material name and the object name through a table that maps the names of each dataset to our categories.
When the names give no category, it is sampled from a prior over the materials of the object class; for example, a chair is wood with probability 0.5, fabric with 0.3, and metal with 0.2.
blocks.zh:
材料类别 物体可以由几个不同材料组成的部分,例如带有木框和织物座的椅子,因此每个部分都收到自己的类别,通过一个将每个数据集的名称映射到我们类别的表格从材料名称和对象名称读取.
当名称不给出分类时,从对象类材料的前置样本中抽取;例如,椅子是概率为0.5的木头,布料为0.3,金属为0.2.

blocks.en:
Optical models The category also fixes the BSDF model, since how a surface scatters light depends on what it is made of.
Most categories use a rough coated model, a diffuse base under a dielectric coating, and matte categories ( e.g . plaster, fabric) use a diffuse model.
In both models, the measured reflectance spectrum sets the diffuse component, and in the coated model the specular reflection follows from the refractive index of the coating alone.
Metals use a rough conductor with wavelength-dependent refractive index and extinction coefficient from measurements of 39 metals [ 47 ] , so their color comes from the measured optical constants instead of a reflectance spectrum.
Transparent categories use a rough dielectric for closed meshes and a thin dielectric for open ones, with a scalar refractive index from measurements or set by category.
blocks.zh:
光学模型 该类还修正了BSDF模型,因为表面散射光如何取决于它是由什么构成的.
大多数类别使用粗糙的涂层模型,在双电涂层下的散射基,而垫层类别(如石膏,布料)使用散射模型.
在两种模型中,测量到的反射光谱设定了散射元件,在涂层模型中,光谱反射仅从涂层的折射指数中遵循.
金属使用波长依赖折射指数的粗导体和从测量39种金属[47]的消失系数,因此其颜色来自测量的光学常数而不是反射谱.
透明分类法采用粗式二电线闭合物和薄式二电线闭合物,并采用测量或按类别设置的缩略镜折射指数。

blocks.en:
Light sources We use the lamps of the source scenes and assign each a lamp type: white and colored LEDs, fluorescent, incandescent, halogen, or high-pressure discharge.
White LEDs span correlated color temperatures from 2700 to 7000 K.
Colored LED lamps use measured spectra of narrowband LED chips [ 12 ] .
Lamp power follows from a target illuminance chosen by room type through the lumen method [ 30 ] .
Daylight comes from a catalogue of spectral sun and sky radiance maps computed with libRadtran [ 22 ] over solar positions and atmospheric conditions, including aerosols and clouds.
blocks.zh:
光源 我们使用源场景的灯具,并指定每个灯具类型:白色和彩色LED,荧光,白炽,卤素,或高压放电.
白色LED的颜色温度为2700至7000K。
彩色LED灯使用测量的窄带LED芯片光谱[12].
灯光功率来自通过Lumen方法通过房间类型选择的目标光芒[30].
日光来自用 libRadtran [22] 计算太阳位置和大气条件,包括气溶胶和云层的光谱太阳和天空光度图目录。

blocks.en: 3.3 Spectral Textures from RGB
blocks.zh: 3.3 RGB的光谱纹理

blocks.en:
Textures carry much of the visual detail of 3D scenes, such as wood grain, fabric patterns, and print, so we convert each RGB texture into a spectral texture instead of giving the surface a single spectrum.
The conversion has two requirements: every texel’s spectrum is made of measured spectra of the surface’s material category, and the color differences between texels, such as gradients and patterns, are preserved.
We give each texel a blend of measured spectra of its material in three steps: (i) compute the CIE XYZ colors of the category’s library spectra under D65 and divide them into tetrahedra with a Delaunay triangulation; (ii) find the tetrahedron that contains the texel color and write this color as a weighted sum of its four corner colors, with non-negative weights that sum to one; (iii) give the texel the same weighted sum of the four corner spectra. The color of a weighted sum of spectra is the same weighted sum of their colors, so the texel keeps its color, and its spectrum consists only of real spectra of its material.
The blend weights also change continuously with the color, so texels of similar color, such as neighboring texels along wood grain, receive similar spectra, so gradients and patterns are kept.
A texel color that the material never takes in our measurements, such as a saturated blue on wood, lies outside all tetrahedra and is moved to the nearest one, which keeps the material at the cost of some color accuracy.
The appearance of the texture under the light sources of a scene then follows from these spectra, not from the RGB values.
blocks.zh:
纹理携带许多3D场景的视觉细节,如木质粒,织物图案,以及印刷品,因此我们将每个RGB纹理转换成光谱纹理,而不是给表面一个单一的光谱.
转换有两个要求:每个texel的光谱都是用地表物质类别的测量光谱制成的,并且保留了texels之间的颜色差异,如梯度和图案.
我们给每个特克塞尔一个测量到的材料的光谱的混合,分三个步骤:(一)计算D65下类库光谱的CIE XYZ颜色,用德劳奈三角法将其分为四面体;(二)找到含有特克塞尔颜色的四面体,并将这个颜色写成其四个角色的加权总和,其中非负数的重量等于一个;(三)给特克塞尔四个角色的加权总和。 光谱的加权总和的颜色与其颜色的加权总和相同,因此特克塞尔保持其颜色,其光谱只包含其材料的真实光谱.
混合重量也随着颜色的不断变化,因此类似颜色的特克塞尔,如邻接的特克塞尔沿木质谷物,得到相似的光谱,因此梯度和图案得到保持.
在我们的测量中,物质从未摄入的特克塞尔色,如木材上的饱和蓝色,位于所有四面体外,并被移到最近的一个,它使材料以一定的颜色精度为代价.
然后,一个场景的光源下纹理的出现来自于这些光谱,而不是来自RGB值.

blocks.zh: 在 D65 下计算该类库光谱的 CIE XYZ 颜色,并以 Delaunay 三角形将其分为四色体;

blocks.zh: 找到含有特克塞尔颜色的四面体,并将这种颜色写成其四个角色的加权和,其中非负重为1;

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate Spectrify on two downstream tasks that use our rendered HSIs in different ways.
In hyperspectral reconstruction, a network recovers an HSI from a RAW image, so the HSIs serve as targets as well as, after projection through a camera’s SSFs, as inputs; this task tests the rendered spectra themselves.
In color constancy, a network estimates the scene illuminant from a RAW image, so only the projection of the spectra is used.
Both tasks use one set of 4,500 rendered HSIs with the same training, validation and test split.
Hyperspectral reconstruction networks trained on one dataset generalize poorly to others, because each dataset covers few scenes [ 27 ] .
We therefore test generalization to four real datasets unseen during training, comparing our data with real data and with the 7,022 synthetic HSIs of Buzzelli et al . [ 14 ] , and measure the contribution of material-based spectral assignment by replacing it with assignment by color alone.
For color constancy, we test on NUS [ 19 ] and Cube++ [ 23 ] , two real datasets that both contain images from the Canon EOS 600D, and compare our data with RawGen [ 36 ] , which produces RAW images without modeling spectra, and with Buzzelli et al . , whose HSIs are projected to RAW through the same SSFs as ours.
blocks.zh:
我们评价Spectrify在两个下游的任务,这些任务以不同的方式利用了我们已经形成的HSI.
在超光谱重建中,一个网络从RAW图像中恢复一个HSI,因此HSI既作为目标,也作为通过相机的SSF投影后的投入;这一任务测试了制成的光谱本身.
在色彩恒定中,一个网络从RAW图像中估算出场景亮度,因此只使用光谱的投影.
这两项任务都使用一套4 500人,使HSI得到同样的训练、验证和测试。
在一个数据集上训练的超光谱重建网络对其它数据集的概括性差,因为每个数据集覆盖的场景很少[27].
因此,我们测试在培训期间未见的4个真实数据集的概括,将我们的数据与真实数据以及Buzzelli等人的7 022个合成HSI进行比较,并通过仅用彩色分配来衡量基于材料的光谱分配的贡献。
对于色彩恒定性,我们在NUS [19] 和 Cube++ [23] 测试两个真实的数据集,两者都包含来自Canon EOS 600D的图像,并将我们的数据与RawGen [36] 进行比较,RawGen 不建模光谱生成RAW图像,与Buzzelli et al.,其HSI通过与我们相同的SSF预测到RAW.

blocks.en: 4.1 Cross-Dataset Generalization of Hyperspectral Reconstruction from RGB
blocks.zh: 4.1 超光谱的跨数据集一般化 从 RGB 重建

blocks.en:
Hyperspectral reconstruction (HSR) networks learn from paired RGB images and HSIs, and existing datasets of such pairs cover few scenes, illuminants and capture devices.
This limited diversity is the main obstacle to applying HSR to real-world images [ 6 , 65 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh:
超光谱重建(HSR)网络从配对的RGB图像和HSI学习,这种配对的现有数据集覆盖了很少的场景,照明剂和捕获设备.
这种有限的多样性是将HSR应用于现实世界图像[6、65、27]的主要障碍。

blocks.en:
We use four real datasets that differ in content and lighting.
ARAD 1K [ 7 ] and ICVL [ 5 ] were collected by the same group and contain mostly daylight scenes.
BJTU-UVA [ 21 ] contains urban and natural scenes captured under different weather, lighting and times of day.
Doomer [ 50 ] mixes indoor scenes lit by halogen and narrow-band LED lamps with outdoor scenes under mostly overcast skies.
Each dataset serves both as a training source and as a test set.
As synthetic training sources we use Spectrify and the pipeline of Buzzelli et al . [ 14 ] , which assigns measured reflectance spectra to the pixels of sRGB photographs.
We remove the spectra of all four real datasets from our reflectance library ( Sec. 3.1 ) before rendering, so the library contains no spectra from the test sets.
blocks.zh:
我们使用四个真正的数据集,在内容和光线上有所不同.
ARAD 1K [7] 和 ICVL [5] 由同一组人收集,主要包含日光场景.
BJTU-UVA [21] 包含在不同天气,照明和白天时间下捕获的城市和自然场景.
Doomer[50] 将卤素灯和窄带LED灯点燃的室内场景与户外场景混合在一起,大多在覆盖的天空下.
每个数据集既是培训来源,又是测试工具。
作为合成训练来源,我们使用Spectrify和Buzzelli等人的管道[14],该管道将测量反射光谱分配给SRGB照片的像素.
在渲染前,我们从我们的反射库(sec. 3.1)中删除所有四个真实数据集的光谱,所以库中没有来自测试集的光谱.

blocks.en:
All HSIs are projected to RAW RGB through the spectral sensitivities of a Nikon D700 camera and corrupted with the same noise model, and every source trains the same MST++ network [ 15 ] (details in Appendix B ).
A network trained on one source is tested on the test split of every real dataset.
When the training and test sets come from the same dataset, the result is in-domain and serves as the reference for that test set.
We report PSNR, SAM and the normalized spectral error (NSE) [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
所有HSI都通过Nikon D700相机的光谱敏感度投射给RAW RGB,并以相同的噪声模型腐蚀,每个源都运行相同的MST++网络[15](详见附录B).
在一个来源上受过训练的网络在每个真实数据集的测试分解上进行测试.
当培训和测试集来自同一数据集时,结果为内域数据,并作为该测试集的参考.
我们报告PSNR、SAM和正常光谱误差[50]。

On ICVL, training on ARAD 1K gives a lower SAM and NSE than training on our data, while our PSNR is slightly higher.
The two datasets come from the same group and contain similar scenes, so for ICVL, ARAD 1K is close to in-domain data.
blocks.zh:
在ICVL上,ARAD 1K的训练比我们的数据训练给予较低的SAM和NSE,而我们的PSNR则略高.
这两个数据集来自同一个组,包含类似的场景,因此对于ICVL,ARAD 1K接近域内数据.

blocks.en:
Networks trained on real data transfer worst to Doomer, whose LED-lit indoor scenes have little or no counterpart in the other real datasets.
Both synthetic sources transfer to Doomer better than any real source, and both include narrow-band LED spectra, which may contribute to this.
On the other three test sets, however, Buzzelli et al . fall behind most real sources, while our data stays first or second.
Since everything except the HSIs is shared, part of this gap may come from how spectra are assigned to surfaces, which we test in Sec. 4.2 .
Results for other HSR methods are given in the supplementary material ( Appendix B ). Figure 5 shows per-pixel errors on two ARAD 1K test images.
blocks.zh:
接受过真实数据培训的网络向Doomer传输最差,其LED-lit室内场景在其他真实数据集中几乎没有或没有对应的.
这两种合成来源都比任何真实来源更好地向杜默转移,两者都包含窄波段LED光谱,这可能对此有所帮助.
但是,在另外三套测试中,Buzzelli等人却落后于大多数真实来源,而我们的数据则停留在第一或第二位。
由于除了HSIs之外的一切都是共享的,因此这一差距的一部分可能来自光谱如何被分配到表面,我们在第4.2节对此进行了测试.
补充材料(附录B)列出了其他高温方法的结果。 图5显示了两个ARAD 1K测试图像上的每像素误差.

blocks.en: 4.2 Effect of Material-Based Spectral Assignment
blocks.zh: 4.2 物质光谱转让的效果

blocks.en:
To validate that spectra should be assigned by material category ( Sec. 3.2 ), we compare two versions of Spectrify that differ only in how surfaces receive their spectra.
With the default material + color assignment, the spectrum of each texel is matched to its color among the library spectra of the surface’s material category.
With color-only assignment, it is matched over the whole library, as in Buzzelli et al . [ 14 ] .
We follow the same protocol as in Sec. 4.1 . Table 2 shows that material + color assignment improves transfer on every test set.
The gain is marginal on ARAD 1K and substantial on the other three.

随着默认的材料+色彩分配,每个texel的光谱在表层材料类别的库光谱中与其颜色相匹配.
如Buzzelli et al. [14]。
我们遵守和塞克一样的程序 4.1 (中文(简体) ). 表2显示材料+色彩分配改进了每个测试集的传输.
所得在ARAD 1K上是微不足道的,在其他三个上是相当可观的.

blocks.en:
Color constancy models are trained on RAW images of one camera, so each new camera needs its own training data.
This experiment checks that RAW images projected from our HSIs can serve as such data, next to existing generators of synthetic RAW images.
We train color constancy models on RAW images from three synthetic sources, Spectrify , RawGen [ 36 ] and Buzzelli et al . [ 14 ] , and use training on real images of the same camera as an in-domain reference.
blocks.zh:
色彩恒定模型在一台相机的RAW图像上进行训练,因此每台新相机都需要自己的训练数据.
这项实验检查表明,从我们的高压成像仪中投射的RAW图像可以作为此类数据,在合成RAW图像的现有生成器旁边.
我们从Spectrify, RawGen[36]和Buzzelli等人.[14]三个合成来源,在RAW图像上训练颜色固态模型,并将同一相机真实图像的培训作为域内参考.

blocks.en:
For every rendered view, we also render an illumination map that records the spectral irradiance arriving at each visible surface point.
It is obtained by replacing, in Eq. 1 , the material at the first camera-ray intersection with a white Lambertian reflector, while later bounces keep the scene materials, so the map includes light reflected by colored surfaces.
The methods we evaluate estimate one illuminant per image, so we project each pixel of the illumination map to RAW through the SSFs of the camera, as we do for the rendered images, and take the median over the map as the ground-truth illuminant.
blocks.zh:
对于每一种观点,我们还绘制出一张照明图,记录到达每个可见表面点的光谱辐照。
它通过在Eq. 1中用白色的兰伯特式反射器取代第一个相机射线交叉处的材料而获得,而后来的反弹保留了场景材料,因此地图包括了由彩色表面反射的光.
我们评价的方法估计每个图像有一个光亮, 所以我们通过相机的SSF将光亮图的每个像素投射到RAW上, 就像我们对渲染的图像所做的那样, 并且把中位数放在地图上作为地面真实的光亮。

blocks.en:
For RawGen, whose original training data and prompts are not public, we use the released checkpoint to generate 3,000 RAW images from text prompts and build the training data as in RawGen [ 36 ] and Graphics2RAW [ 53 ] .
Each image is converted to the RAW space of the camera under an illuminant sampled from the released illuminant set, and this illuminant serves as the label.
For Buzzelli et al . , we follow their pipeline [ 14 ] , which converts each sRGB image to reflectance spectra and renders it under one illuminant spectrum.
The rendered image and the illuminant spectrum are projected to RAW through the same SSFs, and the projected illuminant is the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
RawGen的原始培训数据和提示不公开,我们利用释放的检查站从文本提示中生成3000个RAW图像,并构建培训数据,如RawGen [36] 和Graphics2RAW [53].
每个图像在从释放的光子集取样的光子下转换成相机的RAW空间,这个光子作为标签.
对Buzzelli等人来说,我们跟着他们的管道[14],它把每个sRGB图像转换成反射光谱,使其在一个光谱下.
通过同样的SSF向RAW投射成像和光谱,投射的光谱是地面真理.

blocks.en:
We evaluate four color constancy methods, ConvMean [ 29 ] , FC4 [ 32 ] , FFCC [ 9 ] and SIIE [ 3 ] , on two real datasets, NUS [ 19 ] and Cube++ [ 23 ] , using only images of the Canon EOS 600D, whose SSFs come from CamSpec [ 34 ] .
For each method and training source, we train a separate model from scratch, select it on the validation set of its training source, and test it on real images without fine-tuning.
The in-domain reference is trained on the official training split of the dataset it is tested on, and all models are tested on the official test splits of NUS and Cube++.
We report the angular error between the estimated and the ground-truth illuminant in camera RGB space.
NUS gives one ground-truth illuminant per image, and Cube++ gives two, from the left and right sides of a SpyderCube target [ 23 ] .
Following Cogo et al . [ 20 ] , the error on Cube++ is the mean of two angular errors, one between the estimate and the left-side illuminant and one between the estimate and the right-side illuminant.
blocks.zh:
我们在两个真正的数据集NUS [19] 和Cube++ [23] 上评价四种颜色恒定方法,ConvMean [29],FC4 [32],FFCC [9]和SIIE [3],只使用Canon EOS 600D的图像,其SSF来自CamSpec [34].
对于每一种方法和训练来源,我们从零开始训练一个单独的模型,在它的训练来源的验证组上选择它,并在没有微调的真实图像上进行测试.
域内参考素材对其测试的数据集的官方培训分解进行了培训,所有模型都通过NUS和Cube+的官方测试分解进行测试.
我们报告相机RGB空间中估计值和地面-真实亮度之间的角错。
NUS给每个图像一个地面真实的亮点,Cube++给两个,从SpyderCube目标左右两侧. [23].
继Cogo et al. [20],Cube++上的误差是两个角错的平均值,一个在估计和左侧的灯光之间,一个在估计和右侧的灯光之间.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Spectrify , a framework that converts existing 3D scene datasets into hyperspectral images by assigning measured reflectance spectra by material category and rendering each scene by spectral path tracing.
A hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our data generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on real HSIs on most test sets, and assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set.
For color constancy, RAW images projected from our HSIs are useful training data, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators.
Because RAW images follow from the HSIs by projection, the same rendered data can serve any camera with known SSFs without new captures.
These SSFs, however, are costly to obtain [ 34 , 53 ] .
Combining our data with camera-agnostic methods, which transfer to new cameras without per-camera training data [ 3 , 4 ] , is a natural next step, as is multi-illuminant estimation from the rendered per-pixel illumination maps.
We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Spectrify(Spectrify),这个框架将现有的三维场景数据集转换成超光谱图像,方法是按照材料类别分配测量到的反射光谱,并通过光谱路径跟踪来渲染每个场景.
超光谱重建网络只接受我们数据一般化的训练,可以比大多数测试集中接受过真实的HSI培训的网络更好的隐形真实数据集,并且按照材料类别而不是仅用颜色来分配光谱可以改善每个测试集的这种传输。
对于色彩恒定性而言,来自高压电源的RAW图像是有用的培训数据,与现有的合成RAW发电机相同。
由于RAW图像是通过投影从HSI中遵循的,同样的渲染数据可以服务于任何已知SSF的相机而无需新的捕获.
然而,获得这些特别服务框架的代价很高。
将我们的数据与相机不可知方法结合,这些方法在没有每台相机训练数据[3,4]的情况下转移到新的相机上,是自然的下一步,从得到的每像素照明图中得出的多发光量估计也是如此.
我们发布了4,500个制造的HSI,Spectrify的代码及其材料标记的反射库.

blocks.en:
Most close-range hyperspectral datasets provide no material labels, so we label their pixels automatically with Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) [ 16 ] .
Because SAM 3 works on RGB images, each hyperspectral image is first rendered to sRGB from its 400–700 nm range under the CIE D65 illuminant.
SAM 3 then segments this image once for every material category.
The text prompt is the category name, extended with additional terms for some categories.
Only masks with a confidence above 0.8 are kept.
Spectrophotometer measurements already carry material names, which we map to our categories separately for each source table.

blocks.en: Appendix B Cross-Dataset Evaluation with Other HSR Methods
blocks.zh: 附录B 用其他高温方法进行跨数据集评价

blocks.en:
To check that the benefit of our data does not depend on the reconstruction method, we repeat the cross-dataset evaluation of Sec. 4.1 with three HSR methods of other types, the dictionary-based A+ [ 62 ] , the CNN AWAN [ 42 ] and the Mamba-based GMSR [ 60 ] , in addition to the transformer-based MST++ [ 15 ] of Tab. 1 .
Each method keeps the model hyperparameters of its original paper, and the data, RAW rendering, splits and metrics are those of Sec. 4.1 .
blocks.zh:
为了检查我们的数据的效益不取决于重建方法,我们重复了对Sec.4.1的跨数据集评价,采用了三种其他类型的HSR方法,即基于词典的A+[62],基于CNN的AWAN[42]和基于Mamba的GMSR[60],此外还有Tab.1的基于变压器的MST++[15].
每种方法都保留其原始纸张的模型超参数,数据、RAW渲染、分解和度量衡是Sec.4.1。

blocks.en:
All HSIs are projected to RAW RGB through the spectral sensitivities of a Nikon D700 [ 34 ] , scaled so that the largest channel sum equals one.
We then add Poisson shot noise as in the NTIRE 2022 spectral recovery challenge [ 7 ] , with a full-well capacity of 750 photoelectrons.
The noisy signal is clipped at the saturation level and quantized to 12 bits.
Every training source and every test set goes through the same simulation.
blocks.zh:
所有HSI都通过Nikon D700 [34]的光谱敏感度投射到RAW RGB,缩放时最大通道和等于1。
Poisson在2022光谱回收挑战赛中发出噪音,
噪音信号在饱和度水平上被剪切,并量化为12位.
每个训练来源和每个测试集都经过同样的模拟.

blocks.en:
Every dataset is split into training, validation and test partitions, and all images of one scene stay in the same partition.
The test labels of the ARAD 1K challenge [ 7 ] are not public, so we train on its 899 public training images and divide its 50 official validation images equally between our validation and test partitions.
ICVL [ 5 ] images are grouped by location and capture date, and whole groups are assigned to partitions so that validation and test each hold about 10% of the images.
BJTU-UVA [ 21 ] keeps its official split.
The data of Buzzelli et al . [ 14 ] keeps all renderings of one INTEL-TAU [ 40 ] scene, taken by different cameras, in the same partition, and our data is split by 3D scene, so all views of one scene fall into the same partition.
blocks.zh:
每个数据集被分为训练,验证和测试分区,一个场景的所有图像都留在同一个分区.
ARAD 1K挑战的测试标签[7]并不公开,因此我们对其899个公共培训图像进行培训,并将其50个官方验证图像平分在我们验证和测试分区之间.
ICVL [5] 图像按位置和捕获日期分组,整个组被分配到分区中,这样验证和测试每个组持有约10%的图像.
BJTU-UVA [21]保持官方分拆.
Buzzelli et al. [14]的数据将一个INTEL-TAU [40] 场景的所有渲染,由不同的相机拍摄,在同一分区中,我们的数据被3D场景分割,因此一个场景的所有视图都掉入同一个分区中.

Table 5 shows that the findings of Sec. 4.1 hold for all four methods.
A model trained on one real dataset is worse on every other real dataset in all three metrics.
Training on our data gives the best or second-best out-of-domain result in every column for MST++, AWAN and GMSR, and it outperforms the synthetic HSIs of Buzzelli et al . in every cell for every method.
The advantage of our data therefore does not depend on the reconstruction method.
blocks.zh:
表5显示,第4.1条的结论适用于所有四种方法。
在一个真正的数据集上受过训练的模型,对于所有三个度量中的其他每一个真正的数据集来说,都更糟糕.
关于我们数据的培训在MST++、AWAN和GMSR的每个列中都给出了最佳或次佳的域外结果,它的表现超过了Buzselli等人在每一个细胞中合成的HSI,每种方法都是如此。
因此,我们数据的好处并不取决于重建方法。

Table 5 : Cross-dataset generalization across HSR methods. The table follows Tab. 1 , with one block per method (vertical label), and the MST++ [ 15 ] block repeats Tab. 1 .
Bold marks the best and underline the second-best out-of-domain result per column within each method.
Arrows show whether higher or lower is better.
blocks.zh:
表5:跨HSR方法的跨数据集概括。 该表沿用Tab. 1,每个方法有一个块(垂直标签),MST++[15]块重复Tab. 1.
粗体标记最佳,并突出显示每种方法内每一列的第二最佳域外结果。
箭头显示更高或更低是更好的.
